title: Meadow Wood House – King Suite
house_rules: Rent is all-inclusive: utilities, Wi-Fi and streaming are included.
No smoking inside. Smoking is allowed only outside.
Quiet hours are 10:00 pm to 8:00 am.
shared_spaces: Your bedroom and the basement bathroom are private. The kitchen, living room, laundry (in the basement), back porch with barbecue grill and backyard are shared with other guests.
description:
A private, furnished king bedroom (basement) for stays of 1 to 12 months, in a spacious house on a quiet residential street in Indiana, PA: 3 minutes to Downtown Indiana and 5 minutes to IUP and IRMC Hospital. Sleeps up to 2. You have your own bathroom in the basement, and share the full kitchen, living room and laundry room (in the basement). Relax on the back porch with the barbecue grill or in the big backyard. Free parking in the private driveway, self check-in.

All-inclusive monthly rent: utilities, Wi-Fi and streaming are included. Great for travel nurses, medical professionals, IUP families and long-term guests.
